changes.problem: Construction mutation buttons looked available during atomic rope collection although the coordinator correctly rejected their commands.
changes.solution: Use the shared unavailable-state flag for each physical construction mutation and aria-busy on the panel. Help, reading and Back retain their deliberate interrupt behavior.

changes.problem: Delayed entry focus could arrive after the immediately following Tab key and steal its result.
changes.solution: Establish reader/world entry focus synchronously in useLayoutEffect before paint. The existing immediate-Tab test remains unchanged.
